sources.entry: Gameyfin - Video game library manager with automatic scanning, web access, downloads, and plugin support. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Gameyfin is a self-hosted video game library manager that scans your game folders, fetches metadata and cover art, and serves the collection through a web interface.
summary.what_it_does: Automatically scans and indexes game libraries on disk, then presents them in a browsable web UI accessible from any device with a browser. Metadata and cover images are downloaded and cached locally, so the library works on a LAN. Users can download game files directly from the web UI and share the library with friends and family. It supports themes (including colorblind options), plugins through the PF4J plugin system, and OAuth2 / OpenID Connect for SSO integration. The README says it runs in a container or on any system with a JVM.
use_cases: organize a local video game collection
browse my game library from a web browser
download games from a home server over LAN
share a game library with friends and family
self-host a game library with SSO login
notable: Automatic scanning of game folders with metadata and cover image download
Web UI with direct game downloads and library sharing
caveats: README does not include install or run instructions; documentation is referenced at gameyfin.org
Videos are not cached locally, per the LAN-friendly note
Gameyfin v2 is described as the current Kotlin/Spring Boot version; no further platform limits are stated
